% PGF heart plot marks in a mathematical scatter plot.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{plotmarks}
\pgfplotsset{compat=newest}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=10cm,height=6cm,
    xmin=0,xmax=5,ymin=0,ymax=5,
    axis lines=middle,grid=major,
    xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$f(x)$},
    xtick={1,2,3,4},ytick={1,2,3,4}
  ]
    \addplot[only marks,red!80!black,fill=red!30,
      mark=heart,mark size=8pt] coordinates {(1,1) (2,4)};
    \addplot[only marks,blue!70!black,fill=blue!25,
      mark=heart,mark size=8pt,mark options={rotate=25}]
      coordinates {(3,2) (4,3)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
